observations.what: Floating loans printed with the whole coupon paid in kind ('SF + 6.50 % (j) 10.15 % PIK') are tagged with a spread and a PIK rate and no plain rate. pipeline/financial_conventions.py reads a PIK tag as the coupon only when no spread is filed (pik_only_tag_reading 'coupon'), so the rate is left empty. 128 rows over 13 quarters here, fixed by row correction; the sister fund 0001930087 has the same wrapper settings and very likely the same gap. A wrapper-gated reading (PIK tag above the spread, no plain rate, fund files whole-coupon PIK) would carry forward to new quarters; row corrections do not.
observations.suggested_check: A loan row with a PIK rate, a spread, no plain rate and no published interest rate.
